source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Interpreting Test Results' under topic 7.7 (PDF 102, printed 98).

blocks.text: Test ke nataij interpret karne ka matlab hai samajhna ke statistics ke nateejon ka kya matlab hai. Is mein p-values, confidence levels ya test statistics jaisi qeematon ka analysis shamil hai. Nataij se tay hota hai ke hypothesis accept hota hai ya reject. Researchers ko nataij samajhte waqt data ka context (pas-e-manzar) zaroor dekhna chahiye. Ghalat tashreeh ghalat nateejon tak le jati hai. Durusti ke liye nataij ki wazeh tashreeh zaroori hai, aur sahi interpretation qabil-e-bharosa aur ba-maani nataij deti hai.
